verdict.rationale: Plaid IDV exposes a documented REST API (e.g. /identity_verification/retry) with webhooks, Link SDK callbacks, and structured session/status endpoints, giving programmatic/agentic control over verification flows. However missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found 404s), a plain-markdown docs endpoint, and independent hands-on developer corroboration of API-driven automation beyond docs.
